content.rendered:
Below is the list of projects that have been approved by the Sherwood School District Board of Directors to be scheduled and completed for the summer of 2019 using bond funds.
Status on the progress of the projects will continue to be shared with the Board, as well as updates in the District Newsletter and on this website as news becomes available. 

Overview

The Bond Management Team selected and approved the following projects for construction during the summer of 2019.  The projects were selected based on urgent needs, safety and security, other repair and replacement needs, as well as taking into consideration future use of each building as the transformation projects are set to occur during the summer of 2020. 

Archer Glen

  • Exterior paint
  • Flooring, ceiling
  • Tile replacement
  • Replace wire glazing
  • Music room upgrades
  • HVAC
  • Food service upgrades
  • Parking lot lot updates

Edy Ridge

  • Bird netting additions
  • Interior finishes upgrades
  • HVAC
  • Interior Lighting
  • Food service upgrades

Middleton

  • Roofing

Laurel Ridge

  • Bird netting additions
  • Ceiling tile replacement
  • Interior paint
  • Select foor replacement
  • HVAC
  • Interior lighting
  • Add cooling for the IDF room

Sherwood High School

  • Roofing (Phase 2)
  • Window replacements
  • Commons seating repairs
  • Wooden bleachers updates
  • Intercom repairs
  • HVAC
